acceptance_criteria: A sequence close to a stored example of gesture A is recognised as A; a sequence unlike any example returns unknown
Evaluation trains on some simulated sessions and tests on others, and npm test prints top-1, top-3, unknown recall and false-accept rate
Incompatible feature schema versions and malformed sequences are rejected, not guessed
No runtime dependency is added and no network or DOM API is used by src/recognition
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: Per-profile gesture matching core in pure TypeScript: versioned landmark feature sequences, DTW nearest-example matcher with a first-class unknown result, and a seeded synthetic evaluation that reports top-1, top-3 and false-accept rate split by simulated recording session
non_goals: Camera capture, MediaPipe, UI, storage, any shared cross-child model
Claims about real-world accuracy; synthetic fixtures only prove the pipeline
